# Joseph and Aseneth Chapter 27 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 27:4 — without beginning or end — divine attribute

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "who has no beginning and no end" | Literal — relative clause |
| LOGOS | "without beginning or end" | Prepositional phrase — more elegant |
| PNEUMA | "without beginning or end" | Same as LOGOS |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** LOGOS/PNEUMA agree: 'without beginning or end.' More natural in English as a divine epithet. Adopted LOGOS.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.
